name: Bhudargad Fort
description: Bhudargad is a massive hill fort with extensive ramparts and bastions. It was a key outpost for the Marathas in southern Maharashtra and offers panoramic views of the surrounding region. The fort is mostly in ruins but is a popular destination for trekkers and history buffs.

routes.name: Bhudargad Village Route
routes.description: Gradual ascent through fields and forest patches.

landmarks.name: Ramparts and Bastions
landmarks.description: Extensive fortification walls and bastions, some still intact.

landmarks.name: Main Gate
landmarks.description: Impressive entrance gate with Maratha architecture.

landmarks.name: Viewpoints
landmarks.description: Wide views of the Kolhapur countryside.

history.significance: Key outpost for the Marathas in southern Maharashtra, part of the regional defense system.

reviews: The fort is huge and the ramparts are impressive.
Not much crowd, good for a peaceful trek.
Carry water and snacks, as there are no facilities on the fort.
